name: x_login
description: Login to X/Twitter using a session cookie (auth_token). Required before some operations.

cookie.description: The auth_token cookie value from X.com

name: x_get_profile
description: Get profile information for a user including bio, follower count, etc. Supports Twitter, Bluesky, Threads, and Mastodon.

username.description: Username (without @). For Bluesky: user.bsky.social. For Mastodon: user or user@instance.

instance.description: Mastodon instance URL (e.g. https://mastodon.social). Only needed for Mastodon.

name: x_get_followers
description: Scrape followers for an account. Supports Twitter, Bluesky, Mastodon, and Threads.

limit.description: Maximum number of followers to scrape (default: 100)

instance.description: Mastodon instance URL. Only needed for Mastodon.

name: x_get_following
description: Scrape accounts that a user is following. Supports Twitter, Bluesky, Mastodon, and Threads.

instance.description: Mastodon instance URL. Only needed for Mastodon.

name: x_get_non_followers
description: Get accounts you follow that do not follow you back.

name: x_get_tweets
description: Scrape recent tweets/posts from a user profile. Supports Twitter, Bluesky, Mastodon, and Threads.

instance.description: Mastodon instance URL. Only needed for Mastodon.

name: x_search_tweets
description: Search for tweets/posts matching a query. Supports Twitter, Bluesky, Mastodon, and Threads.

filter.description: Result ranking (default: latest). Use "top" for the highest-engagement results; "latest" returns the newest, which typically have no engagement yet.

instance.description: Mastodon instance URL. Only needed for Mastodon.

name: x_follow
description: Follow an X/Twitter account by username. Requires an authenticated session (XACTIONS_SESSION_COOKIE).

name: x_unfollow
description: Unfollow an X/Twitter account by username. Requires an authenticated session (XACTIONS_SESSION_COOKIE).

name: x_unfollow_non_followers
description: Bulk unfollow accounts that don't follow you back.

name: x_detect_unfollowers
description: Get current followers for comparison. Run periodically to detect unfollowers.

name: x_post_tweet
description: Publish a new tweet from the authenticated account. Returns the posted tweet URL when X reports success.

name: x_like
description: Like a tweet by its URL from the authenticated account. Idempotent: liking an already-liked tweet is a no-op.

url.description: Full URL of the tweet to like

name: x_retweet
description: Retweet (repost) a tweet by its URL from the authenticated account, without adding a quote comment.

url.description: Full URL of the tweet to retweet

name: x_engage
description: Sweep a feed and engage every post on it: like, repost, and reply across a profile, a search, or a list. Replies come from your templates or from an LLM given a plain-language brief. Defaults to a dry run; pass dryRun: false to act. Progress is saved per feed, so a second call skips what the first already did.

username.description: Profile to sweep, without the @. Give exactly one of username, search, or list.

search.description: Search query to sweep instead of a profile

list.description: List ID to sweep instead of a profile (digits from x.com/i/lists/<id>)

comment.description: Reply to each post (default false). Needs prompt or templates.

prompt.description: How the replies should sound, e.g. "supportive, specific, one honest question, no hype". Turns on LLM replies.

persona.description: Optional persona line for the LLM, e.g. "You are @you, a founder building X"

templates.description: Reply templates; {author} and {name} are filled in. Used directly, or as the fallback when the model fails.

model.description: LLM model; provider default if omitted

apiKey.description: LLM API key; falls back to OPENROUTER_API_KEY / OPENAI_API_KEY / XAI_API_KEY / ANTHROPIC_API_KEY

includeReplies.description: Include replies, not just top-level posts

includeReposts.description: Include posts the account reposted from others

since.description: Only posts on or after this ISO date

onlyFrom.description: Only engage posts by these authors (useful on search and list feeds)

skipUsers.description: Never engage posts by these authors

keywords.description: Only posts containing one of these words

skipKeywords.description: Skip posts containing any of these words

minLikes.description: Only posts with at least this many likes

maxLikes.description: Only posts with at most this many likes (0 = no ceiling)

delaySeconds.description: Seconds between posts (default 20). Lower is likelier to be rate limited.

jitterSeconds.description: Random spread added to the delay (default 10)

dryRun.description: Preview without posting. Defaults to true.

reset.description: Forget saved progress for this feed first

resume.description: Read and write saved progress (default true)

name: x_download_video
description: Download the video attached to a tweet and return the local file path plus the resolved media URL and metadata.

tweetUrl.description: URL of the tweet containing video

name: x_update_profile
description: Update your X/Twitter profile fields (name, bio, location, website).

name: x_post_thread
description: Publish a multi-tweet thread from an ordered list of texts. Each entry becomes a reply to the previous one.

tweets.description: Array of tweet texts for the thread (2+ tweets)

name: x_create_poll
description: Create a poll tweet with a question, two to four options, and a duration in minutes (default 24 hours).

name: x_schedule_post
description: Schedule a tweet for future posting (requires Premium).

name: x_delete_tweet
description: Permanently delete one of the authenticated account's tweets by its URL. This cannot be undone.

url.description: Full URL of the tweet to delete

name: x_reply
description: Reply to a tweet by its URL with the given text. The reply is posted from the authenticated account.

url.description: URL of the tweet to reply to

name: x_bookmark
description: Save a tweet to the authenticated account's private bookmarks by its URL so it can be found later.

url.description: URL of the tweet to bookmark

name: x_get_bookmarks
description: List the authenticated account's saved bookmarks, newest first, up to the requested limit.

format.description: Output format: json or csv (default: json)

name: x_clear_bookmarks
description: Clear all bookmarks. This cannot be undone.

name: x_auto_like
description: Auto-like tweets matching keywords in your feed.

keywords.description: Keywords to filter tweets (empty = like all)

name: x_get_trends
description: Get current trending topics on X/Twitter.

category.description: Category filter: trending, news, sports, entertainment

name: x_get_explore
description: Scrape the Explore feed for trending content.

name: x_get_home_timeline
description: Read posts from your home timeline on X/Twitter. Supports For You or Following.

timeline.description: Which home timeline to read (default: for_you)

name: x_get_notifications
description: Scrape your recent notifications with type classification.

filter.description: Filter by type: all, mentions, likes, follows

name: x_mute_user
description: Mute an account by username so its posts stop appearing in the authenticated user's timeline and notifications.

name: x_unmute_user
description: Unmute a previously muted account by username, restoring its posts to the authenticated user's timeline.

name: x_send_dm
description: Send a direct message to an X/Twitter user.

name: x_get_conversations
description: List the authenticated account's direct-message conversations with participants and the latest message preview.

name: x_export_dms
description: Export the authenticated account's direct messages as structured JSON, including sender, text, and timestamps.

name: x_grok_query
description: Query Grok AI on X/Twitter. Requires Premium access.

mode.description: Grok mode: default, deepsearch, think (default: default)

name: x_grok_summarize
description: Use Grok to summarize a topic from X/Twitter posts.

name: x_get_lists
description: List the X Lists the authenticated account owns or follows, with names, member counts, and URLs.

name: x_get_list_members
description: Get members of a specific X/Twitter list.

name: x_get_spaces
description: Discover X Spaces (live audio rooms) by state and topic: live now, scheduled, or recently ended.

name: x_scrape_space
description: Scrape metadata and speakers from a specific Space.

name: x_space_join
description: Join an X Space with an AI voice agent that listens, transcribes, and speaks autonomously. Requires xspace-agent installed and AI API key configured.

provider.description: AI provider: openai, claude, groq (default: openai)

systemPrompt.description: Custom system prompt for the AI agent

name: x_space_leave
description: Leave the currently active X Space and get a summary of the session.

name: x_space_status
description: Get the status of the currently active X Space agent, including duration, transcription count, and recent events.

name: x_space_transcript
description: Get recent transcriptions from the active X Space session.

name: x_get_analytics
description: Fetch the authenticated account's analytics dashboard: impressions, engagements, profile visits, and follower change for the period.

name: x_get_post_analytics
description: Get detailed analytics for a specific post.

name: x_get_settings
description: Get a snapshot of your account settings and privacy configuration.

name: x_toggle_protected
description: Toggle protected (private) account mode.

name: x_get_blocked
description: List the accounts the authenticated user has blocked, with usernames and display names.

name: x_brand_monitor
description: Monitor brand mentions with sentiment analysis.

brand.description: Brand name or keyword to monitor

name: x_competitor_analysis
description: Compare metrics across competitor accounts.

handles.description: Array of competitor handles to analyze

name: x_check_premium
description: Check premium subscription status and available features.

name: x_publish_article
description: Publish a long-form article (requires Premium+).

publish.description: true to publish, false to save as draft (default: false)

name: x_creator_analytics
description: Get creator dashboard analytics including revenue and subscribers.

name: x_analyze_sentiment
description: Analyze the sentiment of text. Returns a score (-1 to 1), label (positive/neutral/negative), confidence, and key sentiment-bearing words. Uses a built-in rule-based analyzer by default (zero dependencies), or optionally an LLM via OpenRouter for nuanced analysis.

text.description: Text to analyze (tweet content, any string)

texts.description: Array of texts for batch analysis (alternative to single text)

name: x_monitor_reputation
description: Start monitoring sentiment for a username or keyword over time. Scrapes mentions periodically, analyzes sentiment, computes rolling averages, detects anomalies, and can trigger webhook alerts.

action.description: Action: "start" (create monitor), "stop" (stop by ID), "list" (list all monitors), "status" (get monitor status by ID)

target.description: Username (with @) or keyword to monitor (required for "start")

type.description: Monitor type: mentions, keyword, replies (default: mentions)

interval.description: Polling interval in seconds (default: 900 = 15 min, minimum: 60)

webhookUrl.description: Webhook URL to POST alerts to

name: x_reputation_report
description: Generate a reputation report for a monitored username. Shows sentiment distribution, top positive/negative mentions, timeline data, keyword frequency, and alerts. Requires an active monitor for the target.

username.description: Username to generate report for (must have active monitor)

format.description: Output format: json or markdown (default: markdown)

name: x_stream_start
description: Start a real-time stream that polls an X/Twitter account and pushes new events. Types: tweet (new tweets), follower (follow/unfollow events), mention (new mentions). Events are emitted via Socket.IO. Rejects duplicates (same type + username).

type.description: Stream type: tweet, follower, or mention

interval.description: Poll interval in seconds (default: 60, minimum: 15, maximum: 3600)

name: x_stream_stop
description: Stop an active real-time stream by its ID. Removes all state and history.

streamId.description: The stream ID returned by x_stream_start

name: x_stream_list
description: List all active real-time streams with status, poll/event counts, errors, and browser pool info.

name: x_stream_pause
description: Pause an active stream (stops polling but retains state). Resume later with x_stream_resume.

name: x_stream_resume
description: Resume a paused stream. Clears backoff and starts polling again immediately.

name: x_stream_status
description: Get detailed status for a single stream including poll count, event count, errors, and backoff info.

name: x_stream_history
description: Get recent events from a stream. Optionally filter by event type.

eventType.description: Optional filter: stream:tweet, stream:follower, or stream:mention

name: x_workflow_create
description: Create a new automation workflow. Workflows chain multiple actions (scrape, filter, summarize, etc.) into pipelines with triggers and conditions.

steps.description: Array of steps. Each step is { action: "scrapeProfile", target: "@user", output: "varName" } or { condition: "varName.field > 100" }

name: x_workflow_run
description: Run a workflow by ID or name. Returns execution results with step-by-step logs.

context.description: Optional initial context variables for the workflow

name: x_workflow_list
description: List all saved workflows with their trigger type, step count, and enabled status.

name: x_workflow_actions
description: List all available actions that can be used in workflow steps (scrapers, transforms, AI, utilities).

name: x_export_account
description: Export a Twitter account: profile, tweets, followers, following, bookmarks. Outputs JSON, CSV, Markdown, and a self-contained HTML archive viewer. Supports resume-on-failure.

only.description: Export only specific data types (default: all)

name: x_migrate_account
description: Migrate exported Twitter data to Bluesky or Mastodon. Supports dry-run mode to preview actions without executing. Requires a prior export.

username.description: Twitter username whose export to migrate (without @)

dryRun.description: Preview only, do not execute (default: true)

exportDir.description: Path to export directory (auto-detected from exports/ if omitted)

name: x_diff_exports
description: Compare two account exports to find new/lost followers, deleted tweets, and engagement changes. Generates a diff report in JSON and Markdown.

dirA.description: Path to the older export directory

dirB.description: Path to the newer export directory

name: x_get_thread
description: Unroll and scrape an entire Twitter/X thread given the URL of the first tweet.

url.description: URL of the first tweet in the thread

name: x_best_time_to_post
description: Analyze a user's tweet history to determine the best times and days to post for maximum engagement.

limit.description: Number of recent tweets to analyze (default: 100)

name: x_account_report
description: Full account report for one or more public X accounts, computed from public data with no login: engagement rate, median interactions per post, posting cadence, content mix (original vs reply vs repost, media and link share), best hour and weekday by median engagement, top posts, top hashtags, and plain-language observations. Pass an array of usernames to get a side-by-side comparison as well. Use this instead of fetching a profile and a timeline separately when the question is about how an account is performing.

username.description: Username without @, or an array of 2 to 4 usernames to compare

limit.description: Posts to sample per account (default 50, max 200). A larger sample gives steadier medians.

name: x_analyze_voice
description: Analyze a user's writing style/voice from their tweets. Returns tone, vocabulary patterns, emoji usage, avg length, and a voice profile. Requires OPENROUTER_API_KEY for full analysis.

name: x_generate_tweet
description: Generate a tweet in the style of a user. First analyzes their voice, then generates content matching their tone. Requires OPENROUTER_API_KEY.

topic.description: Topic or subject for the generated tweet

count.description: Number of tweet variations to generate (default: 3)

style.description: Optional style: hot-take, educational, personal, promotional

type.description: Generate single tweets or a thread (default: tweet)

name: x_rewrite_tweet
description: Rewrite/improve an existing tweet to be more engaging, shorter, add a hook, etc. Uses a voice profile for style matching. Requires OPENROUTER_API_KEY.

username.description: Username whose voice to match for the rewrite (without @)

text.description: The original tweet text to improve

name: x_summarize_thread
description: AI-powered summarization of a Twitter/X thread. Unrolls the thread and generates a concise summary. Requires OPENROUTER_API_KEY.

url.description: URL of the first tweet in the thread

style.description: Summary style: brief, detailed, or bullet (default: brief)

name: x_download_media
description: Download every photo, video and GIF from a profile, a single tweet, a search or a community to local files. Handles the media tab, avatars and banners at original resolution, filename templates, and an archive file so re-runs only fetch what is new. Use this to build or sync a local media archive; use x_get_media to only list media without saving it.

target.description: What to download: "@user", "@user:avatar", "@user:banner", "@user:all", a tweet id or URL, "search:<query>", or "community:<id>".

archive.description: Record downloads so later runs skip what is already saved (default: true).

limit.description: How many source items to walk (default: 100).

dryRun.description: List what would be downloaded without writing files.

name: x_ask
description: Ask how to do something with XActions and get an answer grounded in the toolkit's own documentation, skills, browser scripts and repository, with sources and the exact runnable action (browser script, CLI command or MCP tool). Use this before guessing at a workflow, inventing a script name, or telling a user something is unsupported: it is the toolkit describing itself. Needs no API key.

question.description: A plain-language question, e.g. "how do I unfollow everyone?"

actionsOnly.description: Skip the written answer and return only the matching scripts, commands and tools (fast, no LLM call).

name: x_list_platforms
description: List all supported social media platforms (Twitter, Bluesky, Mastodon, Threads) and their capabilities.

name: x_graph_build
description: Build a social network graph by crawling an account's followers and following. Maps relationships, identifies clusters, bridge accounts, and influence scores. Returns a graph ID for further analysis.

username.description: Twitter username to start crawling from (without @)

depth.description: Crawl depth: 1 = direct connections only, 2 = friends-of-friends (default: 2)

maxNodes.description: Maximum nodes to crawl (default: 500). Lower = faster.

name: x_graph_analyze
description: Analyze a built social graph. Returns: mutual connections, bridge accounts (betweenness centrality), clusters (label propagation), influence ranking (PageRank), ghost followers, orbit analysis (inner circle vs periphery).

name: x_graph_recommendations
description: Get actionable recommendations from a graph: who to follow, who to engage with, competitors to watch, safe accounts to unfollow.

name: x_graph_list
description: List all saved social graphs with their seed account, node/edge counts, and status.

name: x_persona_create
description: Create a new persona for algorithm building and automated account growth. A persona defines niche, topics, engagement strategy, activity patterns, and LLM voice settings. Use presets for quick setup.

preset.description: Niche preset with pre-filled topics, search terms, target accounts, and tone

strategy.description: Engagement strategy (default: moderate). Aggressive = high volume, thoughtleader = quality over quantity

targetAccounts.description: Target accounts to study and engage with (without @)

name: x_persona_list
description: List all saved personas with their stats (sessions, follows, likes, comments, last active).

name: x_persona_status
description: Get detailed status and lifetime stats for a specific persona.

name: x_persona_edit
description: Edit an existing persona configuration (topics, search terms, target accounts, strategy, activity pattern).

name: x_persona_delete
description: Delete a saved persona and all its stored state.

name: x_persona_run
description: Start the 24/7 Algorithm Builder for a persona. Launches headless Puppeteer with LLM-powered engagement (search, like, comment, follow, post). Requires auth token and OPENROUTER_API_KEY for AI comments.

sessions.description: Number of sessions to run (0 = infinite, default: 1 for MCP)

headless.description: Run browser in headless mode (default: true)

name: x_persona_presets
description: List all available niche presets, engagement strategies, and activity patterns for persona creation.

name: x_history_get
description: Get account history / time-series snapshots for a username. Returns followers, following, tweet count over time.

name: x_history_snapshot
description: Take a snapshot of account metrics right now and save to history.

name: x_growth_rate
description: Calculate follower growth rate for an account over N days.

name: x_compare_accounts
description: Compare multiple accounts on a metric over time.

metric.description: Metric to compare: followers_count, following_count, tweet_count

name: x_audience_overlap
description: Analyze follower overlap between two Twitter accounts.

maxFollowers.description: Max followers to fetch per account (default: 5000)

name: x_crm_sync
description: Sync followers of a username into the CRM database.

name: x_crm_tag
description: Attach one or more tags to a contact in the local CRM so it can be found later with x_crm_search or grouped by x_crm_segment.

name: x_crm_search
description: Search CRM contacts by username or display name.

name: x_crm_segment
description: Group the local CRM into segments by tag, follower count, or engagement level and return each segment's contacts.

name: x_bulk_execute
description: Execute bulk follow/unfollow/block/mute from a list of usernames.

name: x_schedule_add
description: Queue a tweet to be posted later at the given ISO timestamp by the local scheduler. Returns the scheduled job id.

name: x_schedule_list
description: List every tweet queued in the local scheduler with its id, text, scheduled time, and status.

name: x_schedule_remove
description: Cancel a queued tweet in the local scheduler by its job id so it is never posted.

name: x_evergreen_analyze
description: Find top-performing evergreen tweets that can be recycled.

name: x_rss_add
description: Subscribe to an RSS or Atom feed URL so new entries can be turned into tweet drafts by x_rss_check.

name: x_rss_check
description: Poll the subscribed RSS feeds for entries published since the last check and stage them as tweet drafts.

name: x_rss_drafts
description: List the tweet drafts generated from RSS feed entries, ready for review, editing, or posting.

name: x_optimize_tweet
description: AI-optimize a tweet for maximum engagement.

name: x_suggest_hashtags
description: Suggest relevant hashtags for a draft tweet based on its topic, current trends, and the account's niche.

name: x_predict_performance
description: Predict how well a tweet will perform (score, strengths, weaknesses).

name: x_generate_variations
description: Generate alternative versions of a tweet.

name: x_notify_send
description: Send a notification to all configured channels (Slack, Discord, Telegram, Email).

name: x_notify_test
description: Send a test notification to a specific channel.

name: x_dataset_list
description: List the locally saved datasets (exports, scrapes, snapshots) with their names, row counts, and timestamps.

name: x_dataset_get
description: Get items from a dataset with pagination.

name: x_team_create
description: Create a named team workspace for shared accounts, roles, and audit history across several operators.

name: x_team_members
description: List the members of a team workspace with their roles and when they were added.

name: x_import_data
description: Import data from Apify, Phantombuster, or CSV format.

data.description: JSON string or CSV data to import

name: x_convert_format
description: Convert data between Apify/Phantombuster/CSV formats.

data.description: Data to convert (JSON string or CSV)

to.description: Target format: apify, phantombuster, csv, socialblade

name: x_get_replies
description: Scrape replies to a specific tweet. Returns reply text, author, timestamp, likes, and nested reply chains.

tweetUrl.description: URL of the tweet to get replies for

name: x_get_hashtag
description: Scrape tweets containing a specific hashtag. More focused than general search — returns trending metrics and top contributors.

name: x_get_likers
description: Get the list of users who liked a specific tweet. Useful for finding engaged audiences.

name: x_get_retweeters
description: Get the list of users who retweeted a specific tweet.

name: x_get_media
description: Scrape all media (images, videos, GIFs) from a user profile. Returns direct download URLs.

name: x_get_recommendations
description: Get "Who to follow" recommendations based on a user or topic. Useful for discovering accounts in a niche.

username.description: Base username for recommendations (optional — uses your account if omitted)

name: x_get_mentions
description: Scrape tweets that mention a specific user. Includes replies, quote tweets, and direct mentions.

name: x_get_quote_tweets
description: Get all quote tweets of a specific tweet. Shows how people are commenting on/sharing a tweet.

name: x_get_likes
description: Scrape tweets that a user has liked. Shows what content a user engages with.

name: x_auto_follow
description: Auto-follow users matching criteria. Specify a source (hashtag, keyword, or target account followers) and optional filters.

source.description: Where to find users to follow

query.description: Hashtag, keyword, or username depending on source

minFollowers.description: Only follow users with at least this many followers

maxFollowers.description: Only follow users with at most this many followers

mustHaveBio.description: Only follow users who have a bio

mustHaveAvatar.description: Only follow users who have a profile picture

name: x_follow_engagers
description: Follow people who engage with a specific account (likers, retweeters, repliers). Great for finding active users in a niche.

username.description: Target account whose engagers to follow

name: x_unfollow_all
description: Mass unfollow everyone you follow. Nuclear option — unfollows ALL accounts. Use with caution.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm mass unfollow

name: x_smart_unfollow
description: Smart unfollow based on criteria: inactive accounts, spam/bot accounts, accounts that never engage with you, or accounts outside your niche.

dryRun.description: Preview who would be unfollowed without actually unfollowing (default: false)

name: x_quote_tweet
description: Quote tweet — retweet with your own comment/text added.

tweetUrl.description: URL of the tweet to quote

name: x_auto_comment
description: Auto-comment on tweets matching a search query. Can use AI-generated or template comments.

query.description: Search query to find tweets to comment on

comment.description: Comment text (or "ai" to generate AI comments)

name: x_auto_retweet
description: Auto-retweet tweets matching a search query or from specific accounts.

query.description: Search query or username to find tweets to retweet

minLikes.description: Only retweet tweets with at least this many likes

name: x_detect_bots
description: Detect bot/spam accounts using heuristic and AI analysis. Checks posting patterns, bio, followers ratio, account age, and tweet content.

deep.description: Deep analysis — also checks tweet timing patterns and content originality (slower, default: false)

name: x_find_influencers
description: Find influencers in a specific niche or topic. Returns accounts ranked by engagement rate, niche relevance, and audience quality.

name: x_smart_target
description: Find ideal accounts to engage with for growth. Uses AI to analyze your niche and find users most likely to follow back or engage.

name: x_crypto_analyze
description: Analyze crypto/token sentiment on X. Scrapes tweets about a coin/token and returns sentiment score, volume, key influencer opinions, and price correlation.

name: x_grok_analyze_image
description: Analyze an image using Grok's multimodal vision capabilities. Extract text, describe content, identify objects, or answer questions about images in tweets.

imageUrl.description: URL of the image to analyze

tweetUrl.description: URL of tweet containing the image (alternative to imageUrl)

question.description: Specific question about the image (default: "Describe this image in detail")

name: x_audience_insights
description: Get detailed audience demographics and interests for an account. Analyzes followers to determine top locations, active hours, interests, and audience quality.

name: x_engagement_report
description: Generate a comprehensive engagement analytics report. Includes engagement rate, best performing content, optimal posting times, and growth trends.

name: x_monitor_account
description: Start monitoring an account for changes: new tweets, bio updates, follower surges, and profile changes. Get real-time alerts.

name: x_monitor_keyword
description: Monitor X for tweets containing specific keywords. Get alerts when new tweets match. Useful for brand monitoring, trend tracking, or competitor alerts.

minLikes.description: Only alert for tweets with this many likes (default: 0)

name: x_follower_alerts
description: Set up alerts for follower changes. Get notified when notable accounts follow/unfollow you, when you hit milestones, or when there are unusual changes.

minFollowerCount.description: Only alert for followers with this many followers themselves (default: 0)

name: x_track_engagement
description: Track engagement metrics for a tweet or account over time. Returns time-series data showing likes, retweets, replies, and impressions growth.

tweetUrl.description: Tweet URL to track (for single tweet tracking)

username.description: Username to track overall engagement (alternative to tweetUrl)

name: x_list_drafts
description: List tool calls held as drafts by the approval gate (XACTIONS_MCP_REQUIRE_APPROVAL). Each draft records the tool, its arguments, when it was created, and whether it is still pending, has been executed, or failed. Newest first.

status.description: Only return drafts in this state (default: all)

name: x_approve_draft
description: Approve a pending draft and execute the stored tool call exactly as it was submitted. Returns the tool result and marks the draft executed; a draft that already ran is refused so nothing is posted twice.

id.description: Draft id returned when the call was held

name: x_discard_draft
description: Delete a draft without executing it. Use this to reject a held write, or to clean up drafts that have already been executed or failed.

name: x_draft_status
description: Show one draft in full: the tool, the arguments it will run with, its current state, and the result or error if it has already been approved.

name: x_action_budget
description: Report the remaining daily action budget for the active account: for each action class (post, reply, like, repost, follow, unfollow, dm, block, mute, delete) the cap, how many actions were used in the rolling 24 hour window, how many remain, and when the next slot frees. Caps persist across restarts and are set by XACTIONS_ACTION_CAPS or ~/.xactions/action-caps.json.

account.description: Account to report on (default: the active session, or "default")
